name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2018-08-13.161.2) introduced by Victorian Senator [Derryn Hinch](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/derryn_hinch) (Derryn Hinch's Justice Party), which means it failed. The amendment would have raised the repaying point, meaning that people with Higher Education Loan Program (HELP) debts would have to earn a higher amount before compulsory repayments begin. ### Motion text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 1, page 3 (line 6), omit "$44,999", substitute "$50,000".*
